'''Pauline E. Mellon''' is an Irish mathematician who works as a professor of mathematics at [[University College Dublin]].{{r|profile}} Her research specialties include [[functional analysis]], the theory of [[Banach space]]s, and the symmetries of [[manifold]]s.{{r|atlas}} From 2019 to 2020 she was president of the [[Irish Mathematical Society]] and has been a member of the [[Royal Irish Academy]]'s Physical, Chemical and Mathematical Sciences committee.{{r|ims}}{{r|profile}}

Mellon was born in [[Avoca, County Wicklow]].{{r|atlas}} She did her undergraduate studies at University College Dublin, and performed research both at the [[University of Tübingen]] and at University College Dublin as part of her graduate studies.{{r|profile}} Her 1990 dissertation, ''Symmetric Banach Manifolds'', was supervised by Seán Dineen.{{r|mg}} She taught at [[St Patrick's College, Maynooth]] before returning to University College Dublin as a lecturer in 1991.{{r|profile}}
